name: Carmine Potirniche
title: Software Engineer

experience.name: Crytica Security
bullets: Architected and built Crytica's multi-tenant administration platform as sole developer: a C backend service, CLI, and JavaScript/PHP web console with 100+ API operations, from requirements to release.
Designed its security model: privilege-separated services, a schema-validated binary IPC protocol, database-enforced RBAC with per-tenant scoping, and a fixed catalog of 300+ prepared SQL statements.
Built the RHEL 9 installer and setup wizard, rewrote the SSH deployment daemon, and wrote a checksum-verified schema migrator; cut full deployments across 3--12 servers to under 5 minutes.
Orchestrated hundreds of AI agents and subagents, gating their work with code review, 2,600+ unit tests run under sanitizers in CI, and black-box end-to-end installs of multi-server environments.
Led a C synchronization rewrite across 9+ distributed ledgers, cutting sync time by 85%.

projects.name: Umbratic
bullets: Built an Electron/React AI workspace backed by a Rust agent runtime and Go model gateway, supporting local inference, self-hosted models, and integrations with Codex and Claude Code.
Implemented an agent execution harness with dependency-aware parallel tools, context compaction, resumable state, bounded retries, cancellation, and permission checks for workspace operations.
Implemented team-filtered Qdrant retrieval, device enrollment, and revocation for managed model access.
Built tools to create and edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs within the AI workspace.

projects.name: GamePack
bullets: Built a cross-platform video review application with React Native/TypeScript, native AVPlayer/MediaPlayer playback, and a Rust/SQLite engine; synchronized frame and timed annotations with threaded feedback.
Designed durable local storage with transactional comment posting, recoverable drafts, and BLAKE3-verified media imports to prevent duplicate copies and make retries idempotent.
Automated CI/CD for macOS and Windows on ARM64/x64, including native tests, macOS signing and notarization, SHA-256-verified updates, and rollback on failed installation.

projects.name: UpDrafted
bullets: Built Next.js/TypeScript recruiting and administration apps with athlete discovery, verification, moderation, Stripe subscriptions, signed webhooks, and Cloudflare R2 storage.
Implemented 14 PostgreSQL row-level security policies, transaction-scoped user context, and AES-256-GCM message encryption; automated Docker builds and deployments with GitHub Actions.
